svg.aria-label: The same question answered without and with the skill
svg.text: > why is the login endpoint so slow?
WITHOUT THE SKILL — 74 WORDS
A few things commonly make a login
endpoint slow. The password hash is
the usual suspect — if bcrypt is
configured with a high cost factor,
that alone can dominate the request.
Beyond that, it's worth checking
whether the user lookup is hitting
an index, whether the session write
is in the same transaction, and [...]
…the premise was false.
WITH THE SKILL — 3 SENTENCES
It isn't. /auth/login is 84 ms p95
over the last 24 h; the slow one is
/auth/refresh at 2.1 s, and the PWA
calls it on every app resume, which
is almost certainly what you're
feeling.
Want me to dig into refresh?
…the answer, in the first sentence.
